coach.title: Practice Coach
coach.betaHint: Experimental — behaviour may change between builds
coach.brainOffHint: No AI coaching — timing feedback only
coach.brainStandardHint: Qwen3 4B. ~2.5 GB download, ~4 GB RAM while running. The floor — runs on CPU if you have no GPU.
coach.brainStudioHint: Qwen3 8B. ~5 GB download, ~8 GB RAM. Richer feedback and practice plans; needs 16 GB of RAM.
coach.brainStudioNeedsRam: Studio needs at least 16 GB of RAM — this machine has less.
coach.brainUpdateHint: Your downloaded model is from an older generation. Updating replaces it with Qwen3.
coach.brainStandardNeedsRam: Standard needs at least 8 GB of RAM — this machine has less.
coach.statusTemplateBuild: Template coach — this build can't run a model
coach.statusNoModel: No model downloaded — using the template coach
coach.statusReadyNotLoaded: Brain ready — loads when you start a session
coach.statusLegacyWeights: Downloaded brain is from an older generation and won't be loaded — update it below
coach.statusWarmingUp: Warming up the brain — using templates until it's ready
coach.tiersAllModel: Tips, reports and chat all use the AI
coach.tiersTipsTemplate: Tips: instant templates · Reports and chat: AI
coach.tiersTipsTemplateMeasured: Tips: instant templates · Reports and chat: AI ({{seconds}}s each)
coach.scoringModeHint: How the coach grades your timing
coach.scoringDefaultDesc: Grades on feel and groove — the right mode for most players. Rewards locking into the pulse, not subdivision-by-subdivision precision.
coach.scoringProDesc: Every subdivision graded against the beat grid. Designed for players drilling tight accuracy — significantly more demanding.
coach.voiceSilentHint: No audio — feedback appears as text only
coach.voiceSpeakHint: Spoken feedback using local text-to-speech after each session segment
coach.verbosityLessHint: Coach only speaks urgent events; calm nudges stay written-only
coach.verbosityDefaultHint: Coach speaks only when the gatekeeper picks the spoken tier
coach.verbosityMoreHint: Coach also speaks written-tier nudges (more talkative)
coach.voiceNameBrainOffHint: Enable the AI Brain to choose a voice
coach.voiceNameSilentHint: Switch Voice on to choose a personality
coach.voiceCorrupted: {{name}} — voice file is corrupted (click Repair below)
coach.voicesEngineMissing: Speech engine is missing — voices can't speak until it's reinstalled.
coach.voicesCorrupted: One or more voice files look corrupted. Re-download to fix.
coach.voicesNotInstalled: Voices aren't installed yet — download to enable spoken coaching.

coachDownload.title: Download AI Model
coachDownload.studioSpec: ~5 GB download · ~8 GB RAM · needs 16 GB
coachDownload.studioDesc: Best quality, most nuanced feedback, strongest Q&A. Handles complex patterns, fast tempos, and polyrhythms.
coachDownload.stdDesc: Good comments, solid Q&A, reliable timing decisions. Best for simple time signatures and moderate tempos.
